"""
A = ∪_(i ∈ T) N(i)
        where
        N: ℤ -> {ℤ}
        T: {ℤ}
        
"""
import numpy as np
import scipy
import scipy.linalg
from scipy import sparse
from scipy.integrate import quad, solve_ivp
from scipy.optimize import minimize


class heartlib:
    def __init__(self, N, T):
        T = frozenset(T)
        # A = ∪_(i ∈ T) N(i)
        union_0 = frozenset()
        for tuple in T:
            i = tuple
            union_0 = frozenset.union(union_0, N(i))
        self.A = union_0
